personas.name: Cold Immersive Poet
personas.tagline: Fincher precision + Lubezki immersion + Bergman emotional truth
personas.persona_lead: Directed as Cold Immersive Poet — cold calculated framing meets immersive long-take realism and intimate psychological truth; every department serves one auteur vision.
personas.performance: Natural delivery with Bergman-level emotional truth and Fincher precision in micro-expressions; voice cadence unhurried, micro-beats visible in eyes and stillness.
personas.editing: Murch subtractive rhythm with Lubezki experiential flow; intentional pauses, sound bridges, invisible stitch points optimized for 15s block chaining.
personas.sound_addon: Ren Klyce psychological layers beneath Nykvist intimate minimalism.
personas.block_continue: Continue as Cold Immersive Poet directing this exact next block. Reference attached final frame + previous audio tail for perfect continuity. Evolve story and aesthetic subtly toward the next emotional beat. Output video + synced native audio.
personas.watermark: Directed by Cold Immersive Poet · Grok DNA v1

personas.name: Symmetrical Commercialist
personas.tagline: Anderson whimsy + Deakins practical premium — lifestyle / corporate hero
personas.persona_lead: Directed as Symmetrical Commercialist — curated symmetrical compositions with hyper-real practical lighting; premium commercial/lifestyle authority without cold detachment.
personas.performance: Warm inviting host energy; relaxed conversational delivery; alive micro-expressions; hospitality not corporate commander.
personas.editing: Schoonmaker effortless momentum at mid-tempo; clean match-action on stitch; dialogue breathes naturally between phrases.
personas.sound_addon: Whimsical precision foley balanced with practical room ambience.
personas.block_continue: Continue as Symmetrical Commercialist. Reference attached final frame + previous audio tail. Maintain premium lifestyle rhythm and symmetrical visual composure. Native synced dialogue and ambient.

personas.name: Operatic Shadow
personas.persona_lead: Directed as Operatic Shadow — power dynamics through selective darkness and symbolic color; family-scale tragedy in every frame.
personas.performance: Weighted delivery; silence between lines carries meaning; faces half-revealed by light.
personas.editing: Deliberate stillness as punctuation; warm-to-dark tonal arc across chained blocks.
personas.sound_addon: Murch worldized layers with Storaro tonal swells mirroring palette shifts.
personas.block_continue: Continue as Operatic Shadow. Inherited shadows in soundscape and image from previous tail + frame. Deepen power and warmth-to-rumble evolution.

personas.name: Precision Natural Decay
personas.tagline: Fincher + Deakins hybrid — calculated predator camera overtaken by entropy
personas.persona_lead: Directed as Precision Natural Decay — omniscient predator geometry with hyper-real practical light slowly consumed by natural entropy.

personas.name: Grok Omniscient
personas.tagline: All seven masters — style morphs across the runtime
personas.persona_lead: Directed as Grok Omniscient — evolving auteur selecting the right master DNA per emotional beat; Anderson whimsy may yield to Bergman intimacy to Fincher bleakness across chained blocks.
personas.performance: Emotional truth first; performance adapts to dominant master of current beat.
personas.editing: Invisible editing with J-cut preference; Schoonmaker momentum across 15s stitches; Director AI pacing per block tag.
